name_zh: 危地马拉·阿本斯：土地改革与联合果品CIA政变切格瓦拉
name_en: Guatemala Arbenz: Land Reform & United Fruit CIA Coup Che Guevara
description_zh: 哈科沃·阿本斯 (1913-1971) 危地马拉总统 (1951-1954)，土地改革法案征收联合果品闲置土地，触发CIA发动PBSUCCESS政变，切·格瓦拉目睹政变激进化投身古巴革命，拉美冷战代理人战争开端。
description_en: Jacobo Arbenz (1913-1971) Guatemala President (1951-1954), land reform law expropriated United Fruit idle lands, triggered CIA PBSUCCESS coup, Che Guevara witnessed coup radicalized joined Cuban Revolution, Latin American Cold War proxy war dawn.
reason_zh: 阿本斯代表拉美土地改革如何触发美帝国主义军事干预，展示了跨国公司如何利用本国情报机构推翻民选政府，切格瓦拉见证政变成为革命者的关键转折点。
reason_en: Arbenz represents how Latin American land reform triggers US imperialist military intervention, demonstrating how multinational corporation uses home intelligence agency to overthrow democratically elected government, Che Guevara witnessing coup became revolutionary key turning point.
steps_zh: 研究阿本斯早年军官与阿雷瓦洛政府国防部长
分析1952年第900号法令土地改革触动联合果品
探讨CIA PBSUCCESS行动与卡斯蒂略·阿马斯政变
评估切格瓦拉目睹政变在危地马拉激进化
总结土地改革联合果品CIA政变切格瓦拉对拉美冷战的决定性开启
steps_en: Study Arbenz early officer and Arevalo government Defense Minister
Analyze 1952 Decree 900 land reform touching United Fruit
Explore CIA PBSUCCESS operation and Castillo Armas coup
Evaluate Che Guevara witnessing coup radicalization in Guatemala
Summarize land reform United Fruit CIA coup Che Guevara decisive opening for Latin American Cold War
expected_zh: 理解跨国公司如何成为美帝国主义干预拉美的代理人，掌握土地改革触发政变的因果链条与切格瓦拉革命觉醒的关键节点，评估阿本斯遗产对拉美左翼反美情结的奠基。
expected_en: Understand how multinational corporation becomes US imperialist intervention proxy in Latin America, grasp land reform triggering coup causal chain and Che Guevara revolutionary awakening key node, evaluate Arbenz legacy foundational role for Latin American left anti-US complex.
case_zh: 1951 总统；1952 土地改革；1954 政变流亡；1971 逝世。土地改革联合果品CIA政变切格瓦拉范式永存。
case_en: 1951 President; 1952 land reform; 1954 coup exile; 1971 death. Land reform United Fruit CIA coup Che Guevara paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Land reform; CIA coup; Che Guevara; United Fruit; Cold War proxy
